name: Kinoshita Kaede
source:
Riku's classmate.

She's a gyaru and good friends with Chika and Kurumi. The three of them can often be seen hanging out together.

She's soft-spoken and often makes random comments, but she has an honest personality and apologizes immediately when she has to.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/ten_sz/]official website[/url]]
